text: The continents have been moving for millions of years and will continue to move.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.questionWording: The continents on which we live have been moving their locations for millions of years and will continue to move in the future.
room.note: 2012 survey; older data. 83% answered correctly (true). NSF reports the share answering correctly; don’t-know is counted on the wrong side.

truthSource.label: USGS, Understanding plate motions
truthSource.oneLine: Plate tectonics is measured directly today; continents move a few centimetres a year.

lesson.tip: Change you can’t see can still be measured: GPS tracks plates moving a few centimeters a year. “I’ve never noticed it” isn’t evidence.
